thread:
Maya: Quick async check-in for the edge-slice rollout :rocket:
Maya: Did: built new service image + feature flag gating, pushed routing change, primed KV cache on slice-7.
Maya: Blocker: seeing a small p95 bump on one g4dn host during cold starts, want SRE to keep an eye.
Maya: Today: hold at 1% for 30m, if no alerts -> ramp to 5%. PR needs a quick review: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321

DeployBot: Canary start confirmed — canary-id=canary-371234, target=1% us-west, metric-collection=enabled. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/371234

Sam: Saw a spike on host i-0a1b2c — p95 from 180ms -> 240ms for ~2m around 14:12. Logs show a lot of KV misses. snippet: `kv_cache.miss_count=128`

Liam: Thanks, digging in. Pattern looks like concurrent prefetches exhausted connection pool. I pushed a small throttle patch to limit prefetch concurrency to 8. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4328

Natalie: I'll adjust alert thresholds temporarily: p95 > 300ms OR error_rate > 0.5% to avoid noisy paging. If either hits, we'll snapshot and rollback.

Maya: Good plan. If metrics stay stable for 30m we go to 5%. Can someone run the smoke curl and post result?

Sam: Running now:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://us-west.api.redwood.ai/v1/edge-slice/health
# {"status":"ok","p95_ms":212,"kv_miss":5}
```

Ops-Oncall: Ack — I'll watch for 45m and keep logs archived. If anything crosses thresholds I'll tag @Natalie and @Maya. Uploading current logs to s3: s3://redwood-prod-logs/rollouts/371234/

DeployBot: Canary metrics at +15m: error_rate=0.01%, p95=205ms, qps=120. No automated rollback triggered. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks. Liam — if your patch looks green can we merge and release before the 5% ramp?

Liam: Tests passing in CI, load test stage looks ok. I'll merge in 5m and cut a hotfix release.

Natalie: Copy. I'll keep the slack thread as the source of truth — ping here when you merge and when Ops sees no alerts after 30m.

Maya: One more ask — please eyeball adaptive batching config in the canary: `batch.max_tokens` still at 2048, consider lowering to 1024 if p95 drifts.

Sam: Noted, will test lowering on a single host if we see drift.

Maya: Thanks team. If all green at +30m i'll post a ramp note and update the rollout doc. :shipit:

DeployBot: Canary complete at +32m: ramp decision=go -> scheduled ramp to 5% in 3m.

Ops-Oncall: All quiet on my side. No alerts. Monitoring until +1h.

Maya: (final) Marking this thread resolved once ramp is confirmed. TY! :raised_hands:
